title: CHR: Veloso case underscores need for stronger OFW safeguards

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Human Rights (CHR) welcomed the grant of an absolute pardon to Mary Jane Veloso, saying her case highlights the vulnerabilities of overseas Filipino workers and the need for stronger safeguards. “From the beginning of her case, Ms. Veloso maintained that she had been deceived by her recruiters into carrying a suitcase containing illegal drugs,” the CHR said in a statement on Tuesday. “Her experience underscores the need for stronger safeguards for migrant workers, particularly women, whose vulnerability may be compounded by poverty, limited access to legal assistance, gender-based discrimination, and barriers in foreign justice systems,” […]...
